title: Cheat sheet of 8 prompt frameworks (RTF, SOLVE, TAG, RACE, DREAM, PACT, CARE, RISE) plus the trick of uploading it to a Claude/ChatGPT Project that writes your starting prompts

tools.name: 8 Prompt Frameworks cheat sheet
tools.detail: one-page landscape PDF 'A one-page cheat sheet for Claude + ChatGPT'

claims: RTF = Role, Task, Format (who to be, what to do, how to output)
SOLVE = Situation, Objective, Limitations, Vision, Execution (business problem step by step)
TAG = Task, Action, Goal (clear outcome without overcomplicating)
RACE = Role, Action, Context, Expectation (enough context for a sharper answer)
DREAM = Define, Research, Execute, Analyse, Measure (strategy, launches, campaigns)
PACT = Problem, Approach, Compromise, Test (think through trade-offs)
CARE = Context, Action, Result, Example (copy a style/format/example)
RISE = Role, Input, Steps, Expectation (messy info into a clear process)
Hack: upload the sheet to a Project and ask the project to draft a starting prompt each time
how_to_steps: Pick the framework that matches the job (see list)
Upload it to a Claude or ChatGPT Project
When starting a task, ask the project to generate the prompt using the right framework
on_screen_only: Framework cards with acronym expansions (listed in claims), e.g. 'FRAMEWORK 02 SOLVE: S=Situation O=Objective L=Limitations V=Vision E=Execution - Best for solving a business problem step-by-step'
ChatGPT 'Prompt Project' screen at the end
